Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Inventaire des Gaz à Effet de Serre?

In this glossary, Inventaire des Gaz à Effet de Serre refers to: Comprehensive report of CO₂, CH₄ and N₂O emissions from vessel operations for regulatory compliance and environmental management.

How is Inventaire des Gaz à Effet de Serre used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Responsable environnement de la compagnie à la flotte : soumettez l'inventaire trimestriel des gaz à effet de serre selon le modèle ISO 14064, incluez les données de fuel voyage et les heures moteur auxiliaire, échéance premier du mois prochain, terminé."

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

Comprehensive report of CO₂, CH₄ and N₂O emissions from vessel operations for regulatory compliance and environmental management.

Operational example

Company environmental officer to fleet: submit quarterly greenhouse gas inventory by ISO 14064 template, include voyage fuel oil data and auxiliary engine hours, deadline first of next month, over.
